description: Land Title Settlement Department - Aluthgama Bogamuwa, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 511800
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains detailed declarations of land ownership determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
